# `tools` tools

2 tools in the `tools` operation domain. This reference covers every tool the server registers, including the ones a default deployment does not expose. See the [tool reference index](index.md) for every domain.

The Summary column on each domain page is the first line of the tool's MCP description. The complete text, including the conditions under which a tool refuses, is the tool handler's docstring under `src/hmcpctl/server_tools/`. An MCP client's `tools/list` carries that docstring's prose as the description and its argument detail in the input schema; `Returns:` and `Raises:` sections are not sent.

| Tool | Effect | Operation | Target | Implementation | Verification | Runtime eligibility | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hmc_invoke_tool` | `destructive` | `tools.invoke` | `none` | `unrecorded` | `unrecorded` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Call one tool this server exposes by name, exactly as a direct call would run it. |
| `hmc_search_tools` | `read` | `tools.search` | `none` | `unrecorded` | `unrecorded` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Find tools this server exposes by intent, or describe one tool by exact name. |
